_comment: Per-package coverage floor. Generated 2026-05-25 from `python3 tools/run_coverage.py` after Tier 1 of the v2.1 testing plan. CI fails if any package drops more than `tolerance_pct` below its floor; raising the floor is encouraged via PR. lib.commands is the lowest by design — large `run()` orchestration paths talk to agent-browser subprocess and are exercised via integration tests (Tier 3).
